rule: Company-stated Chinese names only: the company's own Taiwan registration in the Ministry of Economic Affairs company registry (GCIS open data; the cited query returns the registered name and, where shown, the parent shareholder), its official Chinese website or press release. The registered name is shown without the foreign-company prefix (美商, 新加坡商, 香港商, 英屬維京群島商), the locality prefix (台灣) and the legal-form suffix. Entries fill gaps where Chinese Wikipedia has no Chinese title; no translation and no media transliteration.
